input.command:
cd /task/screenshots && for f in *.png; do
  name="${f%.png}"
  H=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$f")
  # Split into multiple chunks of about 1800px each
  chunk_size=1800
  num_chunks=$(( (H + chunk_size - 1) / chunk_size ))
  for ((i=0; i<num_chunks; i++)); do
    start=$((i * chunk_size))
    actual_h=$chunk_size
    if (( start + chunk_size > H )); then
      actual_h=$((H - start))
    fi
    ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${actual_h}:0:${start},scale=900:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_part${i}.jpg" 2>&1 | tail -1 > /dev/null
  done
  echo "$f: split into $num_chunks parts"
done
